cuts.head: tilt
cuts.placeText: an archaeological dig site — a square excavation pit, string grids, buckets of soil, a canvas tent and a sieve
cuts.scene: she is an assistant crouching at the pit edge brushing soil away from a small find
cuts.outfit: an archaeologist look fitted to her body — a short-sleeved field shirt tied at the waist and short khaki shorts with boots and a hat, bare legs, a plain khaki hat
